headline: Nevish Line Reignites as Heavy Frontline Clashes Grind On
war_summary: Since the last edition, Nevish Line has reignited with fresh base transitions and one position rendered neutral, breaking its prior pause as fighting flared right at the latest filing. Weathered Expanse endures as the conflict's bloodiest theater, posting over twelve thousand casualties in the past two hours amidst continuous fighting around Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Shattered Advance. Severe clashes persist unabated in Callahan's Passage, tallying more than nine thousand combined casualties alongside active turnover at The Latch and Crumbling Post. Stonecradle likewise remains locked in heavy attrition, logging over eighty-six hundred casualties and ongoing base trades near The Reach and Trammel Pool. In Stlican Shelf, opposing forces continue to contest Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, while localized engagements persist in Linn of Mercy and Palantine Berm. Mooring County sustains steep casualty counts without immediate base shifts, whereas maritime and southern sectors remain largely settled across the wider map.
